About Formlabs:
Do you want to change how the world creates?
At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.
We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.
Your Impact: 
We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to spearhead marketing efforts around our prospects and existing customer base to build customer loyalty through engaging campaigns and innovative strategies.
As the Growth Marketing Manager, you will own the customer lifecycle, focusing on prospects, leads, purchase, onboarding,  engagement, retention, and satisfaction. You’ll design and execute strategies that inspire our customers to become repeat buyers and advocates of Formlabs’ cutting-edge 3D printing solutions. By leveraging data, insights, and creative marketing tactics, you’ll ensure that every customer interaction builds loyalty and maximizes lifetime value.
What You'll Do: 
Develop and execute campaigns to drive customer engagement and purchases throughout the whole customer journey - from prospecting to loyal customer across web, email, and other channels.
Design programs for key stages of the customer journey
Develop content and resources that empower customers to maximize the value of their Formlabs products - segmenting by different customer types, geos, etc. as needed
Track, measure, and report on retention and engagement metrics, identifying opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with product, creative, support, and sales teams to bring new products to market, build campaigns, and ensure a seamless customer experience. and launches of new product
Test and optimize campaigns through A/B testing, data analysis, and customer feedback.
About You: 
8+ years in growth, customer, or lifecycle marketing as an analyst, preferably in a hardware technology company
Strong analytical or technical skills  
Strong ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable marketing strategies.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling marketing messages.
A creative mindset with a passion for designing innovative customer campaigns.
A deep understanding of customer needs and a passion for creating exceptional experiences.
Strong bias for action and ability to execute quickly 
Strong curiosity about our customer base, product, and technology 
Experience with marketing email platforms (e.g., Marketo, Klaviyo), CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, BigQuery), ecommerce platforms (e.g., Shopify)
Why Join Us?
Be part of an innovative company at the forefront of the 3D printing industry.
Collaborate with a team of passionate, driven professionals in a fast-paced environment.
Enjoy a culture that values creativity, learning, and delivering excellence.
Our Benefits & Perks:
Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors 
Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats
Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
And of course… unlimited 3D prints
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  
Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.Compensation:
Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.
Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.The annual base pay range for this role is:$100,000—$190,000 USD

We are looking for extraordinary people to build extraordinary products
Our mission is to revolutionise the business travel landscape and enable 1 billion business travellers to plan and re-plan their trips by automating travel management for their companies.

Diversity
With two physical offices in the Netherlands and Latvia, our team works from many locations in the world. We enjoy the diversity of languages, nationalities and cultures. We have 34 nationalities in our team and this number is growing. Are you #35?
Remote roles available
34 nationalities
Relocation opportunities
Good to know

We are looking for talents, the best people in their field. We are building a team that will change the airline industry for good.

High growth rate

We are growing at a rate of 30% yearly, increasing both the number of employees and the scope of their roles.

As we enter new markets and grow our user base, employees have great opportunities for personal and professional growth in a dynamic environment.

We grow – you grow

High growth rate opens vast opportunities for our team members. We create new roles and we want our employees to grow with the organisation.

If you have ambitions to grow or to run a growing team, C Teleport is the right place.

Unique product

We are proud to say that we are working on a product that can revolutionise the market. We are helping customers to find flight that  they can change and cancel.

This provides great value to many businesses, that have uncertain travel plans. For example travelling sales personnel, who may need to adjust their travel on the go.

International experience

C Teleport sells its platform around the world: we have customers on all continents. Our largest markets are in Europe, but we also have customers in Turkey, India, Philippines, China and many other countries.

All of our customers speak English. It is great to work with such an international crowd.

💥⚡🌎 Who we are
We believe we can rid the world of complicated, non-transparent, bureaucratic immigration processes. To make emigration simple and as accessible as possible for everyone!

To do this, we make the emigration process seamless, simple, understandable and inexpensive. We have only existed for a year, but we have helped more than 7,000 people move to Europe!
📖 Lead of B2B sales of immigration services

You'll lead B2B sales of our immigration services, focusing on both consultative sales and fostering client relationships. Key responsibilities include understanding client needs, promoting growth, and providing tailored solutions. Essential skills include immigration expertise and experience with international clients.
up to $8000/m.
stock-options
Remote or in Lisbon
Full time
Responsibilities:
Corporate Client Engagement with Specific Tools: Actively seek out and engage with corporate clients (B2B) using modern tools and platforms such as Apollo, LinkedIn, Pipedrive, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot Sales Hub, Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and SalesLoft. These tools are essential for managing customer relationships, tracking sales pipelines, enhancing sales conversations, and identifying potential customers effectively.
Ethical Sales Approach: Strive to sell services in an ecological manner, avoiding aggressive sales tactics and focusing on consultative and client-centric strategies.
Business Development and Sales Strategy: Generate new business opportunities using existing and potential customer networks. Develop tailored strategies for different client types.
Client Relationship Management: Manage a diverse portfolio of accounts, ensuring long-term success and satisfaction. Act as the primary point of contact and handle individual customer needs and queries.
Consultation and Advisory Services: Provide comprehensive immigration consultations, learning and advising on various types of visas and residencies. Utilize existing immigration experience and enhance knowledge over time.
Performance Monitoring and Conflict Resolution: Monitor sales metrics and company objectives, set and track sales targets, and resolve any conflicts or issues in a timely and effective manner.
Client Relationship and Support Coordination: Foster and manage client relationships, ensuring satisfaction with relocation services. Act as a key communicator between clients and the relocation team, signaling when support is needed and coordinating effectively to resolve any issues swiftly.
Qualifications
Sales Expertise: Proven experience in Sales Account Management, especially in B2B sectors.
English Proficiency: Strong command of English at a C1-2 level.
Immigration Experience: Personal immigration experience, including obtaining foreign residency. Preferably with expertise in European and American immigration processes.
International Market Knowledge: Sales experience in European, American, and BRICS markets, with appreciation for CIS and Russian markets.
Immigration Law Knowledge: Basic to intermediate understanding of European immigration laws, willing to expand knowledge.
CRM and Analytics: Proficient in CRM software and data-driven decision-making.
Communication and Multitasking: Excellent communication and client management skills, capable of handling multiple tasks.
Total Rewards
1.
Compensation: Potential earnings up to $8,000 per month, including bonuses, with a minimum base salary of $2,000. The first two months feature an increased fixed salary to facilitate onboarding and learning.
2.
Flexible Location: Work from any country within ±3 hours of Central European Time (CET). Choose your work location, be it at home, a beach, an office in Lisbon, or any coworking space
3.
Employment Type: Official contract with MigRun.
4.
Team Environment: Collaborative and growth-oriented team committed to making a meaningful impact in the immigration sector.
Who We Are and What We Do
At MigRun, we are on a mission to transform the immigration landscape. We pride ourselves on making immigration processes transparent, straightforward, and eco-friendly. Our platform caters to a diverse audience, aiming to automate and simplify immigration procedures affordably. 2023 marked a year of remarkable achievements for us. We've facilitated over 4,370 immigration and tax consultations, secured more than 1,236 visas and residencies in Spain and Portugal, and obtained 6,800+ residence permits across 16 countries.
Our community has grown to over 205,000 active users and 25,000 social network members, and we've launched a new division for Corporate Services, ensuring smooth, transparent employee relocations globally. Join us on our journey to create a seamless, stress-free immigration experience for everyone. With our innovative technology and dedicated team, we're leading the way in connecting a more inclusive global community. For more details, visit MigRun.
Couldn't find a suitable position, but want to join Migrun’s team?
We can find a place for you and an opportunity to unlock your potential. Tell us more about yourself, what you can do for us, and why you want to join our team.

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



We are seeking a back-end leaning Senior Developer to join our Growth Team, focused on building net-new self-serve experiences, evolving the underlying systems and integrations that power Product Growth, and driving rapid experimentation and feedback loops across our expanding B2B product suites.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - 5+ years of professional software development experience in a production SaaS environment.

 - Strong experience building backend services in a modern language (e.g. Go, Node.js, Ruby, or Python).

 - Deep experience with React and/or TypeScript in customer-facing web applications.

 - Strong understanding of instrumentation, analytics, and defining meaningful success metrics.

 - Ability to operate autonomously, drive initiatives forward, and influence technical direction.

 - Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset.

Bonus points for:

 - Demonstrated experience leading or significantly contributing to experimentation-driven product development.

 - Familiarity with analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Looker, Qualtrics).

 - Experience working in security- or compliance-sensitive domains.

What you can expect:

 - Shape and evolve our experimentation platform (feature flags, instrumentation, data quality, reporting loops).

 - Lead the design and implementation of experiments that drive activation, engagement, and expansion.

 - Partner closely with product, design, and data to refine hypotheses, define measurable outcomes, and interpret results.

 - Balance rapid iteration with long-term architectural health and security.

 - Raise the bar for code quality, observability, and performance across the team.

 - Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and pairing.

 - Identify technical opportunities to unlock new growth mechanisms.

 - See your work directly influence measurable customer and business outcomes.







USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $153,000 USD and $214,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $144,000 CAD and $202,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment

You belong here.

About Fintech FarmWe are a UK fintech creating successful neobanks in emerging markets in partnerships with local traditional banks. The mission is to make banking services accessible, simple and fun to use worldwide and the goal is to launch neobanks in 50+ markets, serving 100m+ customers.
Since our foundation in 2020, we’ve so far launched neobanks in Azerbaijan (2021), Vietnam (2023), Kyrgyzstan (2024), India (2025), Uzbekistan (2025) and Morocco (2026), with around 4 million customers collectively and have more markets on the near horizon!

Why Fintech Farm is a great place to be
Customers. We always go above and beyond to provide an amazing customer experience. And who said that banking has to be boring? We make our apps not just easy but fun to use.
People. We have almost 300 employees and we’re all business partners in our company – each with stock options that give us a real stake in the business. As we grow and succeed, we all share in the upside. We work with strong individuals whom we empower and trust rather than micromanage. We always stay curious and open-minded.

About the role
We're looking for an experienced ASO/SEO & Organic Growth Specialist to take ownership of organic growth across multiple fintech products and markets. You will develop and execute ASO, SEO, SERM, and CRO strategies that drive sustainable user acquisition, improve app store visibility, strengthen brand reputation, and optimize conversion across the customer journey. As we continue expanding into new markets, you'll play a key role in launching and scaling organic growth channels from day one.

What You Will Be Doing
Develop and execute ASO strategies for iOS and Android, including metadata, localization, creative assets, ratings, and reviews management.
Own and optimize App Store and Google Play product pages across multiple markets.
Plan, launch, and analyze A/B tests to improve app store conversion rates and organic visibility.
Build and execute SEO, GEO, and AI SEO strategies to increase qualified traffic and user acquisition.
Conduct keyword research, monitor rankings, and continuously optimize organic performance across products and markets.
Develop and oversee SEO-focused content and blog strategies, from topic planning and content briefs to publication and performance analysis.
Manage Search Engine Reputation Management (SERM), monitor brand mentions, and improve brand sentiment across search and review platforms.
Drive CRO initiatives through funnel analysis, landing page optimization, experimentation, and user behavior insights.
Monitor competitors, market trends, and algorithm updates to identify growth opportunities.
Build and maintain dashboards, track KPIs, and continuously optimize strategies based on performance data.
What You Need To Have
3+ years of hands-on experience in ASO and SEO, ideally working with high-traffic mobile applications.
Strong understanding of App Store and Google Play ranking algorithms, optimization techniques, and best practices.
Experience managing keyword strategies, content optimization, and organic growth initiatives across multiple markets.
Proven experience with app ratings and reviews management, SERM, and reputation monitoring.
Experience with CRO, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and data-driven decision-making.
Strong analytical skills and experience with tools such as AppTweak, Ahrefs, AppFigures, BrandMentions, Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Amplitude.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience coordinating cross-functional teams and external contractors.
English level C1 or higher.
Experience in fintech, banking, or multi-market digital products will be considered a strong advantage.
Who You Are
Data-driven and highly analytical, making decisions based on insights rather than assumptions.
Proactive and ownership-oriented, comfortable managing initiatives end-to-end.
Curious about emerging trends in SEO, ASO, AI, and organic growth.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple markets and priorities.
Collaborative and effective at building relationships across product, design, analytics, and marketing teams.
What We Are Offering
Competitive salary negotiable depending on experience and seniority level.
Share options.
Opportunity to shape organic growth across multiple live fintech products and new market launches.
Full ownership of strategy and execution with direct business impact.
Strong analytics culture and a highly talented international team.
Fully remote work environment.
We are still a start-up and more benefits are on the way.

Привіт!

Ми, Boosta — холдингова ІТ-компанія, що створює, масштабує та інвестує в digital-бізнеси з глобальним потенціалом.

12 років на ринку;
800+ фахівців;
15+ бізнесів.

З 2014 року будуємо бізнеси на Tier-1 ринках — від EdTech і MarTech до FinTech, Health & Fitness, Webtoons та LegalTech. Розвиваємо екосистему для амбітних бізнесів та людей.

Наразі ми шукаємо Team Lead SEO, який(а) очолить команду та напрям масового запуску монобрендових сайтів під європейські ГЕО.

Чим ти будеш займатися?

Побудова та управління 3-ю командою (найм in-house спеціалістів та контроль мережі фрілансерів).
Планування та реалізація стратегії масового запуску монобрендових сайтів під європейські ГЕО.
Контроль повного циклу: від закупівлі доменів до розгортання сайтів та їх монетизації.
Управління бюджетами та ресурсами, аналітика ROI.
Забезпечення досягнення таргетів по FTD.

Що ми очікуємо від тебе?

Досвід в iGaming від 2 років.
Досвід масового запуску: практичний досвід генерації та запуску сайтів у великих обсягах (сотні/тисячі на місяць).
Досвід роботи з ГЕО Європа.
Вміння вибудовувати процеси для фрілансерів та контролювати великі обсяги виконання задач.
Орієнтація на бізнес-метрики (трафік, конверсії, FTD).

Буде плюсом:

Глибоке розуміння автоматизації процесів (генерація контенту, розгортання сайтів, лінкбілдинг).
Досвід роботи з підрядниками/фрілансерами на різних етапах створення сайтів.

Які етапи?

Етап 1: Pre-screen.
Етап 2: Співбесіда.
Етап 3: Тестове завдання.
Етап 4: Обговорення тестового завдання.
Етап 5: Збір рекомендацій.
Етап 6: Job Offer!

Technical SEO

Content & Web SEO

Implement entity and schema strategies that strengthen how LLMs parse and represent Dripify’s content

External SEO / Off-Page Strategy

Конкурентну зарплату (обговорюємо індивідуально на співбесіді)

2,5+ роки практичного досвіду в SEO
Досвід роботи із західними / міжнародними ринками

Ведення SEO-проєктів

Регулярно аналізувати результати та коригувати стратегію.

Взаємодія з linkbuilding та content командами

Координувати роботу інших спеціалістів, залучених до проєкту

Це не позиція для підтримки існуючих процесів. Нам потрібен керівник, який зможе провести аудит поточної стратегії, команди та інфраструктури, зробити SEO прозорим і вимірюваним та побудувати сучасний organic acquisition — від класичного Google Search до AI Search.

 

Головна задача — перетворити SEO на керований канал залучення з прозорою аналітикою, економікою та вимірюваним внеском у бізнес.

 

Обов’язки

Провести повний аудит поточної SEO-функції: стратегія, команда, процеси, сайти, контент, link building, бюджети та ефективність.
Сформувати та реалізувати нову SEO-стратегію за брендами та GEO.
За необхідності перебудувати структуру команди, ролі, процеси та SEO-інфраструктуру.
Побудувати прозору аналітику: visibility/rankings → organic traffic → registrations → FTD → revenue.
Розвивати Technical SEO, Content SEO, Off-page SEO, Link Building та Digital PR як єдину систему.
Вибудувати роботу SEO спільно з Product, Content, PR та BI.
Використовувати PR-можливості, брендові активи та реальні інформаційні приводи для зростання organic visibility та authority.
Розвивати присутність брендів у Google AI Overviews, AI Search та LLM-based search/discovery.

Контролювати бюджети та оцінювати SEO не кількістю створених сторінок, сайтів чи посилань, а його внеском в organic acquisition та бізнес-результат.

 

Вимоги

Сильний практичний досвід у SEO на позиції Head of SEO / SEO Lead або аналогічному рівні.
Глибоке розуміння Technical SEO, Content SEO, Link Building / Off-page SEO та Digital PR.
Досвід управління SEO-командою та її оптимізації/перебудови.
Досвід роботи з висококонкурентними міжнародними GEO; досвід в iGaming/Gambling буде значною перевагою.
Уміння пов’язувати SEO-метрики з бізнес-метриками: registrations, FTD, revenue, ROI/payback.
Сильні аналітичні компетенції та досвід роботи з SEO-даними спільно з BI/продуктовою аналітикою.
Розуміння attribution та здатність відрізняти реальний incremental SEO growth від зростання, спричиненого продуктом, брендом, промо або іншими факторами.
Практичне розуміння AI Search / AI Overviews / LLM visibility / GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) та сучасних підходів до оптимізації присутності бренду в AI-видачі.

Здатність самостійно провести глибокий аудит існуючої SEO-інфраструктури та приймати рішення на основі даних.

 

Кого ми не шукаємо

Керівника, для якого SEO — це насамперед кількість опублікованих статей, придбаних посилань або створених сайтів.
Спеціаліста, стратегія якого переважно будується навколо PBN / satellites / paid link placements без зрозумілої оцінки їхнього комерційного результату.
Head of SEO, який демонструє зростання positions/impressions/traffic, але не може пов’язати його з registrations, FTD та revenue.
Керівника, аналітика якого закінчується на Search Console, Ahrefs або Semrush.
Спеціаліста, який працює виключно підходами класичного SEO та не розуміє, як Search змінюється з розвитком AI.
Керівника, який підтримує існуючу структуру та процеси лише тому, що «так історично склалося».

Людину, яка не готова самостійно глибоко занурюватися в дані, інфраструктуру та роботу своєї команди.

 

Що ми пропонуємо

Керівництво існуючим SEO-напрямом та реальні повноваження для його трансформації.
Можливість змінювати структуру команди, процеси, інструменти та SEO-інфраструктуру.
Роботу з кількома B2C-брендами та міжнародними GEO з основним фокусом на Африку.
Сильну внутрішню BI-інфраструктуру та доступ до business/first-party data для побудови повноцінної SEO-аналітики.
Можливість тісно працювати з PR та використовувати реальні брендові активи, партнерства й великі інформаційні приводи для SEO та Digital PR.
Бюджети для масштабування підходів, ефективність яких підтверджується даними.

Можливість побудувати сучасну SEO-функцію з одночасним фокусом на Google Search та AI Search.

Ми не шукаємо людину, яка буде підтримувати існуючу SEO-машину та звітувати кількістю посилань, сторінок і сайтів.

Super smart, super analytical. You think in models: LTV/CAC, payback curves, marginal ROAS, incrementality. Spreadsheets are not enough for you — you work with raw data.
Proven at scale. You’ve personally run performance campaigns with multi-million-dollar budgets and can show the numbers: spend managed, CAC achieved, growth delivered.
A systems thinker and a builder. You’ve built growth infrastructure from scratch — tracking, attribution, automation, reporting — not just operating someone else’s setup. You’re excited to build the Krisp Growth Operating System with us.
Taste. You instantly spot when a creative, a landing page, or a message is off-brand or just not Krisp. Performance without brand judgment burns money and trust — you have both.
Technical. scripting or working fluently with APIs and AI tools is a strong plus. You automate before you delegate.
High agency. You don’t wait for briefs. You find the opportunity, size it, test it, and scale it.
Fluent English. You’ll work with tier-1 markets (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia) daily.
AI-native

Together we’re going to build the Krisp Growth Operating System — a growth engine where everything that can be automated with AI, is. Campaign creation, creative testing, bid management, analysis, reporting: AI runs the repetitive work, you make the decisions. Efficiency should be at its maximum — one person with the right systems should do the work of a whole team. If AI isn’t already in your campaigns, your analysis, and your daily workflow, this role isn’t for you.

Work from Europe/UK or join us in Yerevan — a fast-growing tech hub with a strong engineering culture and one of the best quality-of-life-to-cost ratios anywhere.

What will you do?

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



This is a Director-level individual contributor role, designed for an experienced leader who drives strategic impact through deep expertise, cross-functional influence, and ownership of key initiatives rather than direct people management.




Reporting to the Senior Director of Product, the Director of Product, AI Growth grows 1Password's new business in artificial intelligence. In this role, you own driving growth for our AI opportunities by identifying which customers we target, which outcomes we win on, and proving it with design customers. You scale growth through our go-to-market organization and through partnerships with the agent ecosystem and channel partners.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Minimum of 8 years of product management experience, including experience carrying a revenue or adoption target, with a preference for experience in security products, agentic products, or developer tools.

 - Experience owning the strategy for a new product area or market entry, and taking it from hypothesis to customers running in production.

 - Experience working directly with enterprise customers on a technical deployment, as the person accountable for the outcome, and turning what those deployments proved into a repeatable motion a sales team can run.

 - Experience building technology partnerships and integrations, including judging where a product should sit in a larger technology ecosystem and working with business development on commercial terms.

 - Technical depth to hold a credible conversation with developers and security architects about how AI agents are built, deployed, and given access to systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to build alignment across go-to-market and engineering teams toward a shared goal, without direct authority over either.

 - Demonstrated ability to make decisions and move work forward with incomplete information in a fast-changing market.

 - Takes ownership end to end, including the work that falls between teams.

 - Works AI-first: uses agents in daily work, and applies their own judgement to decisions, product taste, and customer and internal relationships.

 - Preferred: familiarity with agentic access products, meaning the products that give AI agents credentials and access to the systems they work in.





What you can expect:



GROWTH STRATEGY

 - Own the growth thesis for 1Password's AI opportunities, covering the customer segments we target, the outcomes we deliver that we win on, and the workflows we get embedded into. Revise it as evidence arrives from customers, partners, and the market.

 - Form and test hypotheses using customer feedback, product usage data, partner input, and market research gathered with the go-to-market, product, user experience, and product marketing teams.

 - Lead a weekly business review that brings the voice of the customer, field feedback, and product usage telemetry into one view, so the team can refine targets, forecast the roadmap's impact on growth, and prioritize the blockers that hold adoption back.

 - Identify what stops customers from adopting, and drive each blocker to a resolution with the product team that owns it.


DESIGN CUSTOMER PROGRAM

 - Run the design customer program for new artificial intelligence opportunities, from selecting customers through to delivered outcomes.

 - Act as the general contractor for each design customer: the single person accountable for getting that customer deployed on 1Password for their agentic access, and for delivering the security and convenience outcomes they came for. Coordinate every team the deployment touches, and build what it requires together with a forward deployed engineering team.

 - Bring in solutions engineering, customer success, and product managers to help each customer reach their goal, and run feature betas with the product managers who own those features.

 - Turn what the program proves into the repeatable signal the company needs to scale, meaning the customer evidence, the deployment pattern, and the measured outcomes that the go-to-market and channel teams build sales plays on.

 - Improve the program each cycle so it reaches more design customers, raises delivery success rates and customer satisfaction, and shortens the time it takes the company to commercialize a new product.


PARTNERSHIPS

 - Decide where 1Password should play in the customer's artificial intelligence stack to deliver the most customer value in securing agent access. Agent access can be controlled at several points in that stack, so weigh those points and choose the ones that solve the most of the customer's problem, rather than the ones we fit into most easily. Base the call on how customers run AI today and on how the industry is evolving.

 - Identify and pursue the partnerships that let us play at those points and that complete an end-to-end customer outcome, meaning the outcome a customer cannot reach with 1Password alone.

 - Work with partners to deliver integrations, and find the patterns that let us repeat an integration across similar partners instead of building each one from scratch.

 - Work with the business development team to structure commercial relationships that grow both companies' business and deliver value to shared customers.


SCALE THROUGH THE FIELD AND THE DEVELOPER COMMUNITY

 - Work with product enablement to build demos and enablement content that the field and our channel partners can use without your involvement.

 - Work with developer relations to grow adoption organically among developers, through reference architectures, sample code, and open source contributions.


TRAVEL

 - Travel to design customer sites, partner meetings, and industry events approximately 10 to 20% of a given year.

 



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $238,000 USD and $357,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $208,000 CAD and $312,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.”
 At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.
 We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in practice, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics.
 About the role 
 Developers find us, install the SDK, and start processing audio before we ever speak to them. Thousands of accounts have run audio through our models. Some become customers, but many sit somewhere between a first test and real production use. The opportunity is to identify the accounts with real potential, understand what moves them from testing to paying, and find what makes them grow from there.
 You own that journey, from reaching promising developers and teams to converting and growing them. You use product and usage data to decide where to focus, get involved in promising evaluations early, and close startup and mid-market deals. You also experiment with outbound approaches to reach new prospects, identify ways to expand existing customers, and build and test the pricing and operational systems that make the whole motion work.
 This isn't a conventional sales role or a RevOps role. It is a job for someone who wants to do both. If you only want to close, this will frustrate you. If you only want to analyse, you'll be uncomfortable when a number depends on you picking up the phone.
 Tasks
 Signup to paid — Carry the conversion number. Work out which trials are real, get into the evaluation early, cut time-to-value, and remove what's blocking the purchase.
 Outbound — Own the motion end to end: target lists, sequencing, messaging, cadence, and the tooling. Run experiments and double down on what converts.
 Full-cycle sales — Run startup and mid-market deals end to end: discovery, qualification, technical evaluation, pricing, negotiation, close.
 Expansion and retention — Own NRR. Most start on one model and a fraction of their traffic. Find the next use case, catch the accounts going quiet before they churn, win back the ones that left.
 Account intelligence — Build the scoring layer. Turn usage data into a ranked list, and keep the ICP current as the market moves.
 Rev ops and reporting — Own HubSpot, the funnel model and the monthly numbers. You keep them accurate because we make decisions from them, and everyone from the board down reads the numbers you produce.
 Pricing and packaging — Run experiments on the self-serve tiers: what's in each plan, where the limits sit, what triggers an upgrade. Ship, measure, roll out what lifts conversion.
 AI-native operations — Build agents and automations across your whole role, pipeline generation to revenue operations. We already run this way and you'll extend it.
 Voice of customer — Gather feedback from customer interactions so product knows what to build and marketing knows how to position.
 Requirements
 2–5 years in a commercial role at a startup or scale-up, ideally with an AI, developer, API or infrastructure product, where you carried a number and personally owned part of a funnel. You've worked somewhere growing fast and know what it's like when the playbook doesn't exist yet, the targets move, and nobody hands you a territory.
 You've closed. You can talk about specific deals you won and lost, and what you'd do differently.
 Love data. You can build a funnel in a product analytics tool, interrogate a CRM, write a query to check a hunch, and spot when a number is lying to you. We use PostHog and HubSpot.
 Experiment discipline. You can design a test, judge whether the result means anything, and say so when it doesn't.
 Tool fluency. Claude Code, Codex, Lemlist, HubSpot, PostHog. You're fast on the stack and faster picking up what's next.
 Comfortable with a technical buyer. You can follow a conversation about latency, benchmarks, SDK integration and model behaviour, ask useful questions, and know when to bring an engineer in.
 You sell the way developers buy. Our customers evaluate before they talk to anyone and respond to evidence.
 You use AI daily as an operational tool, not an experiment. You build workflows with it and have opinions about where it helps and where it produces noise.
 Strong copywriting skills and written communication. You're able to A/B test copy and see what customers respond to.
 High agency. You're joining a commercial team still being built, with no established playbook. Your instinct should be to go and find out rather than wait to be briefed.
 Commercial generalist. You're comfortable wearing several hats in a day and don't wait for someone to define the lane.
 Working language is English. German is useful and not required.
 Bonus: you've worked in voice AI, speech or audio before. Not a requirement, but it will shorten your first month. Our customers are building voice agents and the vocabulary is specific. Caring about sound and how it works helps.
 Benefits
 Opportunity to work at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup , backed by top investors.
 Compensation and equity: Competitive salary package, additional benefits and stock options, enabling you to take part in the company’s success.
 Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
 High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
 Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
 Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
 Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.
 If you are ready to lead the charge in revolutionizing Voice AI and drive our startup to new heights, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join the ai-coustics team!

About the team

At RatePunk, paid acquisition is our growth engine. Our web funnels — from quizzes and landing pages to pricing and checkout — turn that traffic into subscribers. How well they perform directly affects how far we can grow.

We’re looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to own web funnel performance, experimentation, and monetisation. You’ll turn customer insights into hypotheses, launch tests, and use the results to improve conversion and revenue. We also work with an AI-enabled design system, so you can create and ship design variations yourself and move quickly from an idea to a live test.

Get ready to

Own web funnel performance — Take responsibility for conversion across our quizzes, landing pages, pricing and checkout. Find where people drop off and build a clear plan for improvement.

Run our experimentation programme — Own the full process: hypothesis backlog, prioritisation, briefs, launch, analysis and verdict. Build a steady pipeline of meaningful tests and increase the pace of learning.

Test what drives revenue — Experiment with pricing, packaging, offers and how we present them. Evaluate how changes affect both conversion and monetisation.

Build funnels for different audiences — Create and improve funnels for paid, SEO, organic and email traffic, adapting the messaging and purchase journey to each audience’s intent. Develop new funnel concepts and localise them for different markets.

Use AI to create and ship variants — Work with our design system and AI tools to produce design and copy variations, iterate on them, and bring finished test variants to launch.

Turn results into shared learning — Analyse every test, make a clear call on the outcome, and maintain a learning library that helps the team make better decisions.

Drive marketing initiatives forward — Take projects from idea to delivery, from funnel localisation to launches such as our WhatsApp agent. Write clear briefs for developers, coordinate implementation, and work with our Creative Lead to connect funnel insights with ad angles.

We expect you to have

Deep practical experience with A/B testing — you’ve run a high volume of performance tests and know how to prioritise hypotheses worth testing.

Monetisation testing experience — you’ve run multiple pricing, packaging or offer tests and understand how to evaluate their impact on revenue.

Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI extensively for design variations, copy and analysis, and can take an output through to a finished result ready to launch.

Experience with testing tools such as VWO, Optimizely, GrowthBook or split-URL setups, and analytics tools such as GA4 or Plausible.

Strong analytical judgement — you can interpret test results, recognise their limitations and explain what the team should do next.

The ability to coordinate technical work — you can write a clear development brief, discuss implementation with developers and understand the effort involved. You don’t need to code.

A strong understanding of funnel psychology and pricing presentation — you can look at a page, identify a potential barrier to purchase, and turn it into a testable hypothesis.

Strong English conversion copywriting and messaging judgement — you can write and critique headlines, hooks and page copy, and build hypotheses from customer insights.

Big plus if you have experience with:

Subscription/D2C funnels, paid acquisition, funnels for SEO, organic or referral traffic, localisation and multi-market testing, or SQL/BigQuery.

If you’re someone who can combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation and hands-on execution to drive growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary

Gross salary range is 3900-6000 EUR/month.

Location

Vilnius office – we follow a 3-day onsite, 2-day remote hybrid model.

Speaking of perks:

Boost your daily life
Every breakthrough needs a spark, and our daily setup is designed to support it. Enjoy a pet-friendly office, fresh breakfasts, hot lunches, and fully stocked drawers and fridges for a quick snack or even a team-cooked meal together. Rooftop and cellar events keep things lively, while a public transport card for Vilnius and access to Perks.lt benefits help make everyday life a little easier.

DESCRIPTION & REQUIREMENTS

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson and Revel
Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development
Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN International is a global leader in audio-related products and solutions. In this role, you will serve as a Specialist, Marketing General for the Consumer Audio business, contributing to the development and execution of mid- to long-term marketing communications strategies to support business growth in the Japan market.

You will be responsible for digital-first marketing communications across the Consumer Audio portfolio, covering key product categories such as speakers, headphones, amplifiers, and microphones, and spanning multiple HARMAN brands including JBL, Harman Kardon, and Mark Levinson. You will also collaborate with local stakeholders to enhance the customer journey and support the successful launch of new products in line with GTM plans.

Working in close collaboration with global marketing and cross-functional teams, you will help ensure effective execution of marketing initiatives while maintaining strong alignment with global brand direction, which requires a high level of English proficiency for seamless communication. Ultimately, you will contribute to achieving business objectives while supporting sustainable brand growth and long-term brand equity in the Japan market.

This position reports to Sr Manager, Marketing, Consumer Audio, Japan.

What You Will Do

· Develop and execute digital-first marketing communications strategies for the Consumer Audio portfolio in Japan, with a strong emphasis on brand storytelling, product positioning, and culturally relevant content creation

· Plan and implement digital marketing initiatives in Japan, including creative development and advertising execution in collaboration with external agencies, management of owned media (including social media), influencer marketing, and marketing events

· Contribute to the successful launch of new products by executing social-centric digital marketing activities aligned with GTM plans defined by the Japan Product Marketing team, including teaser campaigns, launch day activations, and sustained post-launch community engagement

· Lead the creation and curation of compelling visual and written content for social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and emerging channels), ensuring alignment with JBL's global brand identity while resonating with local Japanese youth culture and lifestyle trends

· Own the social media content calendar and community management, driving engagement, follower growth, and brand affinity through platform-native formats including short-form video, UGC campaigns, and interactive storytelling

· Collaborate with Shopper Experience and Product Media Relations teams to enhance a seamless customer journey across all touchpoints, ensuring social content bridges awareness and conversion

· Collaborate with global marketing and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and effective execution; serve as the local voice and cultural gatekeeper for JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG or other Harman-owned brands expression in Japan

· Translate global product positioning into locally resonant messaging and creative concepts that differentiate JBL within Japan's competitive audio and lifestyle landscape

· Monitor and evaluate campaign performance and social media metrics (engagement rate, share of voice, sentiment, content efficiency), and identify opportunities to continuously optimize activities to improve effectiveness and efficiency

What You Need to Be Successful

· Proven experience in marketing communications, with a strong focus on digital marketing

· Demonstrated ability to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns

· Demonstrated experience in influencer marketing and partnership management, including the ability to build and manage relationships with external creators, media, and strategic partners

· Strong proficiency in English for effective communication in a global business environment, along with native-level Japanese language skills and the ability to create and critically review marketing copy at a high standard in Japanese

· Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

· Solid understanding of brand management and consumer engagement, combined with hands-on experience in social media platforms (such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X), with active engagement in content creation and emerging trends

· Ability to work effectively in a global and cross-functional environment

· Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights

· Strong understanding of product positioning and brand architecture — ability to translate technical product features into emotional consumer benefits and lifestyle narratives

Bonus Points if You Have

· Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

· Experience in consumer electronics or in marketing globally recognized consumer brands with strong brand equity

· Expertise in social media strategy and content planning

· Experience in e-commerce or performance marketing

· Familiarity with GTM planning and product launch processes

· Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, social media analytics platforms) to measure and optimize campaign performance

· Experience in content creation or storytelling for digital and social media platforms

· Experience in managing agencies or external partners

· Passion for music culture, audio technology, and youth lifestyle trends in Japan

What Makes You Eligible

· 5+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in marketing communications or digital marketing roles

· Fluency in Japanese and high proficiency in English for business communication

· Eligibility to work in Japan

· Be willing to travel up to 5%, domestic only

· Be willing to work in the office (Harman flex policy allows office/remote work in alignment with your manager)

· Successfully complete a background investigation/Aptitude Test as a condition of employment

What We Offer

· Opportunity to work with globally recognized audio brands such as JBL, Harman Kardon, and Mark Levinson

· A collaborative and international work environment within a global organization

· Exposure to end-to-end marketing activities across multiple channels and touchpoints

· Opportunities for professional growth and development in marketing and brand management

· A dynamic workplace that encourages innovation, creativity, and continuous learning

· We offer an authentic diverse, equal, and inclusive work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development in a truly global organization.

· You will work on products and services that touch people’s lives and will change the industrial standards, being a part of the transformations in our industry.

· Our work environments are fast paced, challenging, empowering, collaborative, flexible and exciting.

· We offer our own HARMAN University with regular updates on the new technologies and trends by utilizing various sessions organized by Self Learning and Development Trainings to help grow and advance talent.

· We offer competitive compensation/benefit programs and recognition programs.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology 
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  


Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands.  This is an exciting opportunity to impact how our artists are discovered and how they engage with fans around the world.

 Collaborate with artists, managers, marketing & wider digital team members & external agencies to bring your ideas to life

 DIGITAL MARKETING 
 Work with Marketing & our inhouse Planners, to create holistic media plans across platforms, adhering to project budgets.
 Deliver market-leading and creative campaigns from concept to execution across all areas of business to continually meet strategic goals.
 Pitch & execute digital partner opportunities for artists.
 Steer the planning and execution of influencer marketing opportunities (both organic and paid)
 Drive digital and new technology innovation to position artists and RCA UK as industry leaders
 CONTENT DEVELOPMENT

 Work with Marketing & Creative teams to direct an artist’s social assets for optimum performance (eg. engagement)
 COMMUNITY/AUDIENCE DEVELOPMENT 
 Work alongside agencies, CRM & UK International team to grow & engage Domestic and International audiences. – ensuring subscriber growth & engagement targets are set and plans in place.
 Work with Owned Platforms team to establish and optimise artist owned properties
 Work with label analyst to generate regular reports and insight interpret overall campaign performance to ensure KPIs are met & new opportunities are targeted.

 You have strong experience in a frontline label, or within a major label digital adjacent role.
 You are a highly motivated, curious thinker with an active interest and passion for digital marketing, who thrives in an ever-changing environment.
 We are looking for someone who is completely immersed in internet culture and aware of current TikTok, meme and other trends and also emerging platforms and technology.
 You are a collaborative team player who can work with the wider team to deliver on shared business and campaign goals.

 You are a committed project manager who can organise a varied and full workload, prioritise, work under pressure and problem solve to see an idea through to completion.
 You can utilise data to inform digital strategy and understand results whilst also taking a creative approach to idea generation & innovation.
 You understand the UK recorded music market and its use of social content, creator marketing and viral trends to amplify records.

Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “ teaching machines to hear like human beings. ”
 At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like PolyAI, LiveKit, Telnyx, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.
 We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers.
 About the role 
 We have a small but mighty marketing team that produce excellent content and campaigns — launches, videos, case studies, and a brand that punches above our size. What we need is someone who can ensure that these reach the right people at the right time and build a growth engine around them.
 That's this role. You'll drive the growth side of marketing at ai-coustics: the measurement that tells us what's working, the new channel experiments that help us expand reach, and the funnel that converts signups into active and happy developers. You'll also be the bridge into sales — surfacing the accounts worth chasing, and turning our content into the material that helps close them.
 Tasks
 Funnel and conversion — Manage the path from content to signup to activated user: CTA strategy by channel, landing pages, onboarding flow.
 Lifecycle and email — Build the email programme looking at onboarding, activation, re-engagement, launch sends.
 Organic discovery — Run SEO and GEO as a continuous programme, including how we surface inside LLMs.
 Experimentation — Run a steady cadence of tests across pages, messaging and channels, including our first paid experiments. Form a hypothesis, ship it, evaluate, and expand.
 Account-based marketing — Work with our sales and partnerships team to identify and outreach to our target accounts, build and act on intent signals on our website and product, building sales enablement materials and personalised campaigns that capture their attention.
 Measurement and attribution — Own the analytics layer and reporting across PostHog and HubSpot: the events, funnels and dashboards that show where developers and accounts come from, and where they drop off.
 AI-native operations — Build agents and automations into your own workflows, from research and reporting to campaign ops.
 Requirements
 1–3 years in growth, lifecycle, performance or product marketing, where you personally owned a channel or a funnel and can show what changed because of you.
 Genuinely comfortable with data. You can set up event tracking, build a funnel in a product analytics tool, interrogate a CRM, and spot when a number is lying to you.
 Hands-on with the tooling: product analytics (we use PostHog), CRM and marketing automation (HubSpot), and the CMS and email tools around them.
 You use AI daily as an operational tool, not an experiment. You build workflows with it, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it produces noise.
 You write clearly — well enough to ship an email sequence, a landing page or a sales one-pager without a handoff. Not a content specialist, but you know what great looks like.
 You've worked alongside sales in a B2B setting and understand that marketing's job is pipeline, not traffic. You'd rather review customer call notes than guess what buyers care about.
 Comfortable working with engineers to get things shipped — tracking implemented, signup flow changed, site fixed. You can write a clear ticket, and hold your ground on why it matters.
 Fast learner with high agency. You're joining a function with no established playbook, and your instinct is to go and find out rather than wait to be briefed.
 Comfortable marketing to developers, or clearly motivated to learn how. Our audience is engineers building voice products, and they are unusually good at ignoring marketing.
 Working language is English.
 Benefits
 Opportunity to work at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup , backed by top investors.
 Compensation and equity: Competitive salary package, additional benefits and stock options, enabling you to take part in the company’s success.
 Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
 High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
 Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
 Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
 Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.

We’re honored to be named one of America's Best Startup Employers 2021-2022, 2024, 2026 by Forbes
 Job Overview 
 We’re looking for a Content & SEO Writer who can create useful, well-researched content that deserves to rank and is worth reading once people get there.
 The main focus of this role is long-form and SEO content. This includes blog articles, pillar pages, research-based content, product and solution pages, comparison pages, free tools, templates, and other content built around organic search and our broader marketing goals.
 Research is a major part of the job. We don’t want content that simply summarizes what already exists on the first page of Google. You should be comfortable digging into a topic, working with different sources, analyzing competitors, talking to internal experts when needed, and turning what you learn into something clear, specific, and genuinely useful.
 You’ll also work with AI tools as part of the content process. We expect you to know where AI saves time and where it makes content worse. You should be able to direct it, challenge its output, fact-check it, rewrite it, and spot generic AI copy immediately. Our stance is that AI can support the work but it should never be the one making the editorial decisions.
 What you’ll work on 
 Your main responsibility will be creating and improving content across several areas:
 Write in-depth blog articles, pillar pages, research pieces, guides, and other long-form content.
 Create SEO-focused pages for products, solutions, free tools, templates, comparisons, topics, agencies, reviews, API/MCP-related use cases, and other parts of the HypeAuditor website.
 Update existing blog and website content when rankings, search intent, product information, or market conditions change.
 Research topics before writing. This may include SERP analysis, competitor research, industry sources, reports, original data, customer insights, and input from internal experts.
 Turn complex information, product functionality, and data into content that is easy to understand without oversimplifying it.
 Work with SEO requirements such as search intent, keywords, page structure, internal linking, metadata, and content gaps without making the text sound as if it was written for a search engine.
 Help build and maintain content clusters and pillar strategies.
 Support selected marketing projects such as newsletters, email sequences, landing pages, and campaign content when needed.
 Edit and improve existing content for clarity, accuracy, usefulness, structure, and tone.
 Work with SEO, Product, Marketing, Design, and other teams to gather information and get content published.
 Review content performance and use the results to improve existing pages and inform future content.
 What we’re looking for 
 3+ years of professional writing experience, with a strong portfolio of long-form content.
 Excellent written English . You should be able to write clearly, naturally, and precisely for an international and US-focused audience.
 Strong research skills. You know how to investigate a topic rather than simply rewrite existing articles.
 Practical SEO knowledge. You understand search intent, keywords, SERPs, content gaps, page structure, internal linking, and on-page SEO.
 The ability to balance SEO requirements with readability and actual value for the reader.
 Experience writing about SaaS, B2B, marketing, technology, or another field where understanding the subject matters as much as writing about it.
 The ability to understand complex concepts quickly and explain them in plain English.
 Good editorial judgment. You can tell the difference between a useful paragraph and one that merely sounds polished.
 Strong fact-checking habits and attention to detail.
 The ability to work independently, take ownership of a piece from research to final draft, and know when you need input from someone else.
 Experience using AI tools as part of a professional writing workflow.
 .
 How we expect you to work with AI 
 AI proficiency for us does not mean being good at generating an article from one prompt.
 You should know how to use AI for tasks where it actually helps: exploring a topic, working through ideas, organizing research, testing structures, processing information, editing, or speeding up repetitive parts of the workflow.
 At the same time, you should be able to recognize its limitations. That means catching unsupported claims, shallow reasoning, fake specificity, repetitive structures, awkward phrasing, unnecessary summaries, inflated language, and text that says a lot without giving the reader much information.
 You will remain responsible for the research, argument, structure, accuracy, tone, and final quality of everything you publish.
 Nice to have 
 Experience with influencer marketing or MarTech would be useful, as would experience with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4, Google Search Console, and CMS platforms.
 Experience working with original datasets, surveys, experts, or research reports would also be a strong advantage.

 • 100% paid sick leave, 20 working days of annual leave per year, the option to choose days off for public holidays (an additional 13 days of annual leave per year);
 • Absence of bureaucracy, flexibility, and speed in decision-making;
 • Preferential conditions for health insurance;
 • Quick interview process;
 • Fully remote job;
 • Great team & supportive colleagues 🙂

Transform and analyze large datasets in BigQuery and Amplitude to discover product & growth opportunities, trends, anomalies, and actionable insights across the user journey.

5+ years in growth, product, or marketing analytics in a B2C or SaaS environment, with experience working on user acquisition, pricing, monetization, and/or migration initiatives in subscription-based products.
Strong SQL skills and experience with BigQuery or similar cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake); proficiency in Tableau/Looker/etc. for reporting and complex data visualization and product analytics tooling. Amplitude/Mixpanel/Heap/Hotjar/PostHog for event/property tracking and user journey tracking.
