About Replika
 In 2017, no one knew what AI was supposed to be. We built the world's first consumer AI app. Two million people showed up in two months. Today it's over 40 million, and the thing they keep telling us hasn't changed: it helped. It made their life better, steadier, a little less alone. 
 Most AI is built for tasks, not for people. It gives you answers, but it doesn't care what you do with them. AI doesn't just need intelligence. It needs intention. Because the real question isn't just what AI can do. It's what AI is for. 
 When the world's leading researchers wanted to understand whether AI could actually change someone's life, they studied Replika, because there was nothing else to study. What they found at Stanford, at Harvard, across years of research, was that Replika doesn't replace human connection. It deepens it. People become more social, more confident, more themselves. Not in theory. In their actual lives. 
 Every major AI company talks about their mission for humanity. None of them has ever clearly said what they're trying to do for a single person. We will. We want to help you flourish in real life. Not become a better version of yourself, just more yourself. Strong relationships. Better health. Meaning. Momentum. A life that feels worth living while you're living it. 
 We're building the kind of AI that follows up. That knows the people in your life and nudges you to reach out when it matters. That sends you a poem, just because. The goal is conversations that lead somewhere real. Maybe it's a text you send to a long lost friend. A hobby you pick up again. A moment you show up for yourself. 
 Everyone else is building AI that thinks. We're building AI that cares. 
 Technical SEO & GEO Specialist 
About this role
 People find Replika in three places: Google, the app stores, and more and more, AI assistants. When someone asks for an AI companion, Replika should be the answer in all three. Right now nobody owns that work end to end. You will. 
 This is a hands-on role. You'll help set our organic strategy across web, app stores and AI answers, then do the work yourself: fix the site, ship the pages, run the store listings, and get Replika recommended when someone asks ChatGPT or Gemini for an app like ours. No agency layer, no handing it off. 
 Your number is organic revenue. The goal is to grow it 2% every month through June 2027, and keep it compounding after that. 
 3-month contract position, with the opportunity to extend or convert to permanent. 
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Own technical SEO for replika.com. Crawling, indexing, site speed, structured data, internal linking, and whatever else is holding our pages back. 
 Own ASO on the App Store and Google Play. Most new mobile users find us through a store search, so this matters as much as the web. Titles, subtitles, keyword fields and short descriptions for every localization that counts, chosen on real search volume and rank, not guesswork. 
 Make the listings convert. Screenshots, preview video, custom product pages for our top search terms, in-app events, Play Store listing experiments and ratings. Test them and keep what wins. 
 Get every change through review. Our category gets close scrutiny from App Review and Google Play, and you'll know the guidelines well enough to grow reach without putting a release at risk.

Track how often we're cited and how we're described, find the sources those answers draw on, and change what they say: our own pages, structured data, comparison lists, reviews and community threads. 
 Build the pages people are searching for. Plan feature and comparison pages with our content writer, ship them, and measure what they bring in. 
 Set the roadmap and run it. Decide what matters most each month, ship it, and report what moved and what didn't. 
 What We’re Looking For 
 Hands-on SEO experience for a consumer product, with results you can show in traffic and revenue, not just rankings.

 Proven GEO results. On a recent project you grew how often a brand gets named and recommended in AI answers, and you can show the before and after. This isn't a role to learn GEO in. You've already done it and it worked. 
 Proven ASO results on both the App Store and Google Play: keyword and metadata work that moved rankings and installs, and listing tests that lifted conversion, ideally across several localizations. 
 Comfortable with data. Search Console, analytics, App Store Connect and Play Console, an ASO tool like AppTweak, and building your own reports when nobody else will.

Intro 
 We believe talent is everywhere. The chance to live from it isn't.
 Millions of creators are talented and invisible at the same time. The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once. Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours.
 Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them.
 The role: Getting from 150,000 creators on the platform to 10,000 creators living from it is a growth problem, and it's yours. You own the creator side of our marketplace end to end: how creators find us, how fast they book their first campaign, and why they keep coming back. We're looking for a Growth Lead who thinks in equations, not channels: someone who can break creator growth into its parts, find the one term that's holding the rest back, and move it. You report directly to the founders. DACH is the starting point, and international expansion begins in Q1.
 Tasks 
 What you'll do: 
 Take our creator funnel apart, from first touch to signup, first booking, and repeat bookings, and tell us where the leverage is and where we're leaking
 Bulk of your time: Run growth experiments, kill the losers fast, and scale the winners
 Own the creator numbers: acquisition and CAC, retention rate, booking speed, booked revenue and all other relevant creator growth metrics.
 Build and run lifecycle and email marketing that gets creators activated, booked, and back for the next campaign
 Oversee performance marketing for creator acquisition, with your own budget logic and a clear view of what a creator is worth
 Work closely with product: onboarding, activation, and everything that decides whether a creator books in minutes or drops off
 Turn what works into playbooks that hold up outside DACH, so launching the next market is a rollout, not a restart
 Build creator events as a growth channel, similar to what we do for advertisers with"The30"(the30berlin.com)
 Every initiative starts with a hypothesis, an expected outcome, and a number that decides whether it live. You measure outcomes, not activity. 
 Requirements 
 You're a strong fit if.. 
 You've founded a company or led growth at a startup or scale-up, and you can show what you moved: the metric, the starting point, and where you left it
 You're a numbers person first. You build your own analysis, you're at home in SQL or a serious spreadsheet, and you don't wait for a dashboard to exist before forming an opinion
 You find bottlenecks for a living: given a funnel, you can say which step is worth fixing and which ones are a distraction
 You're a real allrounder across analytics, email and lifecycle marketing, and performance marketing, and you've done each of them hands-on, not just briefed an agency
 You understand product well enough to know when the fix is a campaign and when it's a change to the onboarding flow
 High agency and full ownership: you treat the creator funnel like your own P&L, and you'd rather ship a test today than present a strategy next month
 Fluent English, ideally German too, since DACH is where we start. Ideally you also know the creator economy from the inside
 Not expected: 
 A specific number of years on your CV. We care about what you built and what you moved, not how long it took you to get here
 A background in creator or influencer marketing. Strong growth people learn the market fast, we learned the reverse is rarer.
 Benefits 
 Why work at WePush 
 This is a rare chance to own one half of a marketplace that already works. WePush is backed by operators who built the creator and music industry from the inside, including former leaders from Spotify and Google. The demand side is there, the product is live, and 150,000 creators are already on the platform, so you're not starting from zero, you're deciding where the next 10x comes from. You'll work directly with the founders, your decisions show up in the numbers within weeks, and the playbooks you write become how WePush launches every new market.
 Why you might not want this 
 This role isn't for everyone, and that's on purpose. You own numbers that are visible to the whole company, and there's nowhere to hide when they don't move. Most experiments fail, including the ones you were sure about, and if that frustrates you more than it interests you, you'll be miserable here. 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and meaningful equity, you'll own part of what you're building
 Full ownership of creator growth, reporting directly to the founders
 The chance to take your playbooks international from Q1
 A spot in our Berlin office with a fast-moving, in-person team
 Public transport pass, gym membership, and recurring team lunches
 Regardless of who you are, where you come from, how you look, or what music is playing in your headphones, you are welcome.
 If you think in bets and want a marketplace to prove it on, this role is for you.

Growth Manager (Eney AI Assistant)
REMOTE AVAILABLE
FULL TIME
Apply Now

At MacPaw, we craft software that makes everyday tech life simpler, cleaner, and more enjoyable. From globally loved products like CleanMyMac and Setapp to emerging cybersecurity tools like ClearVPN and Moonlock, we are building a product ecosystem that reaches millions of people worldwide.

We believe humans and technology can reach their greatest potential together. By fusing high engineering standards, thoughtful design, and practical AI, we rethink how people interact with their devices and shape the daily tech routines of the future.

Working at MacPaw means owning outcomes, not just tasks. We build for global scale from day one, giving you the trust, freedom, and room to experiment.

In our team, we challenge ideas directly, support each other genuinely, and build software that makes a meaningful difference — both in the tech world and beyond.

We're looking for a Growth Manager to join the team behind Eney, a brand-new AI product just beginning its journey to market.

Eney is designed to change how Mac users interact with their devices. It helps them stay organized, automate routine tasks, and focus on what matters most — and it's currently moving from preview into general availability.

As a Growth Manager, you'll own the conversion and activation layer of the funnel — from the moment a user lands on our page to the moment they become an engaged user of the product. You'll design and run experiments, identify friction points in onboarding and monetization flows, and partner closely with Product, Analytics, and Marketing to move the metrics that matter. The work you do here will directly shape how people discover, try, and stick with Eney.

If you're energized by the idea of working on something new, moving fast, and seeing your decisions reflected directly in the numbers — we'd love to hear from you.

In this role, you will:

Conduct a full-funnel audit of Eney's onboarding, monetization, retention and acquisition flows to identify leakage points and tracking gaps in partnership with Analytics

Design, instrument, and run A/B tests focused on onboarding optimization and pricing/packaging variations — establishing baseline conversion metrics and clear test readouts

Own landing page conversion rate: analyze session recordings, identify friction, propose and ship improvements

Propose and launch structured monetization tests — bundle offerings, localized pricing variants, win-back campaigns — and measure lift on ARPU

Partner with Marketing and Product to deploy automated onboarding sequences and churn intercept triggers based on user behavioral segmentation

Contribute to revenue forecasting — tracking growth levers, modeling the impact of experiments, and aligning on targets with the team

Bring a hypothesis-driven mindset to every test: write clear specs, define success criteria, and present readouts — including what didn't work and what you learned

Skills you'll need to bring:

3–6 years in growth, product, or marketing analytics roles — with hands-on ownership of conversion or activation outcomes

Experience in B2C SaaS, e-commerce, or AI/productivity products

Proven experience running A/B tests end-to-end: from hypothesis to instrumentation to readout; familiarity with tools like Growthbook, Optimizely, Adobe Target, or Split.io

Comfortable with product analytics, funnels, cohorts, and basic statistical concepts — you can write a clear experiment spec and sanity-check your own data

Experience with pricing and purchase flow optimization — understanding what drives conversion and how to test your way to the right price

Strong collaboration skills across product, analytics, and marketing; comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones

Upper-Intermediate English

As a plus:

Exposure to subscription or freemium monetization models

Familiarity with AI tools for automating growth workflows

Experience with AI product monetization — token economy, credit-based pricing, subscription vs. one-time payment models, or freemium-to-paid conversion for AI tools

Acronis is a world leader in cyber protection, delivering natively integrated solutions that monitor, control, and protect the data that businesses and lives depend on. Driven by our passion to protect every workload, we have built the industry’s only all-in-one cyber protection platform. We are looking for a Senior Growth Partner Manager to join our mission of protecting the digital world.
As a Senior Growth Partner Manager, you will bring account management experience and a passion for data protection and cybersecurity. You will work as part of the Sales Channel Management organization and be aligned with a portfolio of service providers utilizing Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud. Your main goals will be to drive annual recurring revenue growth through account planning with dedicated partners, increase adoption of new services, retain partners, and create a best-in-class partner experience. 
 What You'll Do 
 Conduct territory analysis and planning for dedicated geographies to identify high-potential partners, build relationships with key partner decisionmakers, and maintain an appropriate contact cadence based on partner priority.
 Align with Acronis Cloud Distributors on joint channel enablement activities and drive quarter-over-quarter cloud revenue growth through assigned partners.
 Train new and existing partners on current and new products, provide day-to-day business and technology support, and guide partners through onboarding and enablement by equipping them with the required knowledge, resources, and tools.
 Perform account planning for all managed partners, tailoring the level of detail based on each partner’s engagement, loyalty, and responsiveness.
 Motivate and enable partners to sell Acronis services to their existing customer base, attract new customers, and retain existing customers.
 Drive partner satisfaction and act as a trusted advisor and single point of contact throughout the entire partner lifecycle.
 Drive successful upsell and cross-sell initiatives with each partner to increase the new services attach rate.
 Engage and orchestrate the internal resources needed to support dedicated partner growth, including Presales and Technical Support teams.
 Profile every managed partner, including the vendors and tools they sell or use, and maintain this information in Partner Passport.
 Own partner lifecycle management and maintain a regular set of activities focused on education, evangelization, and partner commitments.
 Conduct recurring business reviews and account planning discussions. 
 Drive adoption and utilization of Acronis products, services, and partner programs. 
 Visit and meet partners at least once a quarter; ensure all partners are touched at least once a month through a proactive engagement
 Support onboarding, enablement, certification, and training initiatives. 
 Promote partner participation in marketing campaigns, webinars, customer events, and lead generation activities. 
 Identify opportunities to expand usage, increase customer penetration, and improve partner performance. 
 Provide guidance on sales motions, service packaging, and customer acquisition best practices. 
 Monitor partner performance and proactively address risks impacting growth or engagement. 
 Maintain account plans, activity tracking, pipeline visibility, and forecast updates. 
 Collaborate with internal teams to support partner success and issue resolution. 
 What You Bring 
 5+ years of sales and marketing experience in the software industry, preferably in channel sales, partner account management, or channel development within a software vendor.
 Proven experience in a cybersecurity company, demonstrating a strong understanding of industry practices and protocols.
 In-depth channel and field sales experience with an understanding of the cloud market business model
 Strong presentation, communication, and planning skills
 Strong internal customer focus with desire to learn all aspects of the business
 High level of discipline, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
 Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
 Outstanding organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills.
 Collaborative team player with a strong commitment to success and a “never give up” attitude.
 Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision
 Who We Are 
Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for managed service providers (MSPs), small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), enterprise IT departments, and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyber threats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs, with a unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.
A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis has over twenty years of innovation, with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1,800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages across 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.
Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities we serve. Mutual trust, respect, and the belief that we can contribute to the world every day are the cornerstones of our team. Each member of our “A-Team” plays an instrumental role in driving the success of our innovative and expanding business. About Formlabs:
Do you want to change how the world creates?
At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.
We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.
About Form Now
Form Now is a startup within Formlabs, backed by a small, fast-moving team of about 20 people. It's the next step in furthering Formlabs' mission: giving anyone, from individual builders to engineering teams, access to high-quality 3D printing without owning a printer. Users upload a model, choose from high quality materials, and Formlabs handles production, bridging the gap between idea and reality without the upfront cost of a machine. As the sole marketer for this business, you'll have full ownership of a marketing function and the challenge of scaling it from the ground up.
Your Impact: 
We're looking for a Marketing Generalist to own growth for Form Now end to end. We need someone who can wear many hats, from working on customer acquisition, to launching and iterating quickly on new campaigns. You'll need to be strong analytically, comfortable running email, events, and LinkedIn outreach, and willing to try channels you haven't touched before. You'll work directly with leadership to connect what the product can do with how we message and sell it to new customers.
Breadth matters more than depth here. We'd rather have someone who can move fast across five channels than someone who's only ever gone deep on one.
What You’ll Do:
Use analytics to identify where Form Now should grow next: which customer segments, which channels, and which campaigns are actually working
Own campaign effectiveness end to end: set up email and LinkedIn campaigns, run them, and measure what drove results
Independently plan and execute events as a channel for reaching new B2B customers, from small businesses to medium and large accounts
Connect Form Now's product roadmap to marketing: turn what the product does into positioning and messaging that lands with buyers
Pull together campaign analysis, competitive tracking, and channel experiments into a coherent growth plan you own end to end
Make A/B testing and fast iteration a habit rather than an occasional exercise; ship, measure, adjust, repeat
Write and manage customer-facing copy and email, from acquisition sequences to lifecycle messaging
Use AI tools, including Claude, as a daily part of the job to move faster on research, campaign builds, and analysis
About You:
2-10 years of B2B marketing or growth experience; slope and grit matter more than years
A track record of taking on projects solo, from concept through execution, and knowing how you measured success
Comfortable being customer-facing when the job calls for it
Strong analytically: you can build a manageable tracking system, read your own campaign data, and act on it without waiting for someone else to hand you a dashboard
Have run or set up events independently
Growth mindset: you're not precious about the channel you know best and you'll try new approaches quickly
High energy and not afraid to be scrappy; a startup-within-a-startup environment means undefined problems and few guardrails
Use AI tools fluently in your daily work, held to the same quality bar as your own
Bonus Skills: 
B2B experience specifically
Experience with data analytics and visualization tools (GBQ/SQL, DataStudio/Looker, etc.)
Comfortable with copywriting and customer marketing, even if it's not your primary strength
You've built your own tools, whether that's a scraper for a prospect list, an automation that stitches two tools together, or a landing page you shipped without waiting for design.
Our Benefits & Perks:
Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
401K matching and access to financial advisors
Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats
Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
And of course… unlimited 3D prints
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  
Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.
 Compensation:
Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.
Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.The annual base pay range for this role is:$115,000—$175,000 USD

 At Carmoola, we're changing the way people get on the road – making it faster, fairer, and entirely built around the customer. We've reimagined car finance from the ground up with a seamless digital experience that puts drivers in control.

 Your mission 🏢
 You'll be the T-shaped engine of our performance team and a driving force behind our multi-channel campaigns - helping us run smarter, tighter and faster across Meta and Google, with the opportunity to expand into channels such as CRM and affiliate marketing as we grow.  We're looking for someone who gets energy from rolling up their sleeves: launching tests, building and launching campaigns, checking performance dashboards, spotting trends and pushing constant iteration.

 You're a self-starter who sets your own priorities and keeps people in the loop

 TikTok and/or affiliate experience

 💪 Real ownership: you'll own our paid channels and landing pages, with a clear path to grow the role as you deliver

Growth Manager (Middle+ / Senior)

Location: Remote
Employment: Full-time

About IntellectoKids

IntellectoKids is one of the world's leading EdTech apps for children aged 2–7, with 6M+ downloads worldwide. 

Our mission: make screen time smart, engaging, and educational.

About the role

We're expanding our Growth Team and looking for a Growth Manager who wants to own a meaningful part of our growth engine.

Your primary goal will be to grow revenue through funnel optimization, monetization, pricing, and experimentation.

You won't be given a fixed list of A/B tests to execute. You'll be expected to understand the numbers, identify the biggest opportunities, formulate hypotheses, and turn the best ones into experiments and scalable solutions.

You'll own growth and experimentation across our web and app funnels, working closely with UA, Creative, Product, and Analytics.

Over time, as you demonstrate strong results and ownership, you'll take on more responsibility for the growth roadmap and have the opportunity to grow into a Lead Growth Manager role.

What you'll do

Own and grow revenue across our web and app funnels, optimizing landing pages, paywalls, offers, pricing, and other key funnel stages across 150+ countries

Build and run a structured A/B testing pipeline — from identifying high-impact opportunities and formulating hypotheses to experiment design, analysis, and implementation

Analyze growth analytics, cohorts, behavioral data, unit economics, and LTV to identify opportunities, understand what drives performance, and validate LTV predictions when needed

Independently turn growth hypotheses into requirements for design and development

Work closely with UA and Creative teams to understand traffic performance and build tailored funnels for new audience segments and traffic sources

Research markets, competitors, trends, and user behavior to identify new growth opportunities, including new pricing models, funnel configurations, and other monetization initiatives

Use AI tools where they can meaningfully improve research, analysis, experimentation, or operational efficiency

Present results and recommendations to leadership and gradually take ownership of a larger part of the growth roadmap

What we're looking for

3+ years of experience in growth, product growth, CRO, or performance marketing roles

2+ years of experience working with subscription products and funnels across different paid traffic sources, including Meta, Google, and AppLovin; experience with mobile apps is a strong plus

Proven track record of improving conversion, monetization, or revenue metrics — not just running experiments, but understanding which problems are worth solving

Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, paywalls, pricing optimization, unit economics, and core growth metrics

Excellent analytical thinking and comfort working with data; ability to turn data and user behavior into clear hypotheses and business decisions

Understanding of cohort analysis and LTV, including how LTV prediction models work and how to interpret and validate their results

Experience with web payment infrastructure (e.g. Stripe, Solidgate)

Experience with app monetization and app growth, including App Store / Google Play billing, in-app purchases, ASO, Custom Product Pages (CPP), and analyzing App Store / Google Play performance data

Experience working with international products, including funnel localization and pricing across markets

Strong ownership mindset: you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks

English B2+

Nice to have

Experience in kids, family, or EdTech products

Experience managing or mentoring team members

Experience using AI tools to improve research, analysis, experimentation, or operational workflows

Our benefits

A high degree of autonomy and ownership

Fully remote work and flexible schedule

Paid vacation and sick leave

Fixed salary + performance-based bonus

Opportunity to grow into a Lead Growth Manager role

Hiring process

Intro call with recruiter

Interview with Head of Growth — experience deep-dive, 60 min

Practical case — funnel/pricing analysis and experiment design, 45 min

References — feedback provided by your managers/colleagues

Interview with CEO — 30 min

CAREERS AT KRISP
Growth Marketing Head
Yerevan/Europe/UK
Hybrid/Remote

We’re hiring a Growth Marketing Head to scale Krisp’s prosumer and SMB business — one brand, one growth engine, massive headroom.

Millions use Krisp today — but our voice AI should be used by tens of millions of prosumers and SMB team members in their meetings, and by hundreds of thousands of SMB call centers worldwide. Closing that gap is your job.

We’re not starting from zero. We have strong product and SEO teams, and channels that already work — organic, brand, ads, affiliate. What we need is the person who scales them: pours fuel on the channels that are working, builds paid acquisition into a major growth engine, and measures everything ruthlessly. The emphasis is on performance marketing and measurement — turning budget into growth, scientifically.

This is not a “manage the agency” role. You’ll build and run the growth engine with your own hands.

Locations

Yerevan, Armenia, or remote from Europe/UK. Remote candidates must spend the first month with us in Yerevan, and a few weeks per quarter after that. Relocation to Armenia is a big plus — we cover it.

What you’ll do
Performance marketing at scale. Multi-million-dollar annual budgets across paid search, paid social, creator and emerging channels. You own targets, spend efficiency, and channel strategy for both products.
Scaling what already works. Established channels are producing — your job is to find the headroom in each, invest where marginal returns are best, and take them to the next order of magnitude.
Measurement. Attribution, incrementality, LTV and payback models, cohort analysis, campaign dashboards. Every dollar and every channel measured — you build your own reports, query your own data, and find growth others miss.
The experiment machine. Hypotheses, tests, and scaling decisions run as a system — high velocity, clean measurement, no guessing. You decide what to kill and what to 10x, based on data.
Automation & tooling. Bid management, creative testing pipelines, audience syncs, reporting — if it can be automated, you automate it.
Two growth motions. KrispWork’s high-volume prosumer and SMB funnels are different games. You’ll run both and know when to apply which playbook.
What we are looking for
Super smart, super analytical. You think in models: LTV/CAC, payback curves, marginal ROAS, incrementality. Spreadsheets are not enough for you — you work with raw data.
Proven at scale. You’ve personally run performance campaigns with multi-million-dollar budgets and can show the numbers: spend managed, CAC achieved, growth delivered.
A systems thinker and a builder. You’ve built growth infrastructure from scratch — tracking, attribution, automation, reporting — not just operating someone else’s setup. You’re excited to build the Krisp Growth Operating System with us.
Taste. You instantly spot when a creative, a landing page, or a message is off-brand or just not Krisp. Performance without brand judgment burns money and trust — you have both.
Technical. scripting or working fluently with APIs and AI tools is a strong plus. You automate before you delegate.
High agency. You don’t wait for briefs. You find the opportunity, size it, test it, and scale it.
Fluent English. You’ll work with tier-1 markets (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia) daily.
AI-native

Together we’re going to build the Krisp Growth Operating System — a growth engine where everything that can be automated with AI, is. Campaign creation, creative testing, bid management, analysis, reporting: AI runs the repetitive work, you make the decisions. Efficiency should be at its maximum — one person with the right systems should do the work of a whole team. If AI isn’t already in your campaigns, your analysis, and your daily workflow, this role isn’t for you.

How to apply

All interested candidates are encouraged to apply through this form.
We highly appreciate all applications, however, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stages.

Why join
Scale two proven products inside one of the world’s leading voice AI companies — global brand, millions of users, markets that are still wide open.
Real budgets, real leverage: your decisions move millions in spend and millions of users.
Zero bureaucracy, direct access to leadership, maximum speed.
Maximum transparency — you’ll see the numbers, the strategy, and the reasoning behind every decision.
High compensation and meaningful equity — we’ll walk you through the comp math in the first conversation.
Work from Europe/UK or join us in Yerevan — a fast-growing tech hub with a strong engineering culture and one of the best quality-of-life-to-cost ratios anywhere.
Krisp is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All applicants are considered regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. All employees and contractors of Krisp treat each other with respect and empathy.

Come work with us at Factorial
Welcome to the company where people grow. Our goal is to help other companies succeed, but we always start with our people first. How? By helping you become the best version of yourself!
Our values

Understanding our values will give you a deeper sense of what truly matters to us, why we exist, and what kind of impact we strive to make in the world.

Do you feel identified? Then maybe there is a match.

We own it
We lead by example and inspire those around us.
We partner
We trust our peers and work as a team. We support and encourage each other to achieve success.
We learn and teach
We're curious, and we want to know more every day and pass it along to our peers to get stronger.
We grow fast
Get out of your comfort zone! We keep pace with the market, that's why "flexibility" and "efficiency" are key concepts.
Factorial team benefits

Join the fastest growing start-up in Barcelona. High standards in product quality, software development, customer care and go to market teams. Competitive salary and many opportunities to grow.

Gym membership
Access over 2000 fitness centers (gyms, yoga studios, climbing walls, …) for free by being part of Factorial —we’ve got you covered!
Health insurance
Get super complete health insurance across Spain and travel insurance in many countries by joining our team.
Sponsored coffee pass
Enjoy from the Syra cafeteria, right in front of the office, with discounts on coffee and food. Cheers!
Learning
Keep learning continuously by participating in our on-site conferences, events, and workshops.
Afterworks & Social activities
Themed afterworks, team events and parties. Have they told you about our annual trip to the outskirts of Barcelona? The entire Factorial team together for a few days.
Weekly breakfast
Share breakfast with the whole team! Fresh fruit, pastries, smoothies, etc.

About Formlabs:
Do you want to change how the world creates?
At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.
We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.
Your Impact: 
We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to spearhead marketing efforts around our prospects and existing customer base to build customer loyalty through engaging campaigns and innovative strategies.
As the Growth Marketing Manager, you will own the customer lifecycle, focusing on prospects, leads, purchase, onboarding,  engagement, retention, and satisfaction. You’ll design and execute strategies that inspire our customers to become repeat buyers and advocates of Formlabs’ cutting-edge 3D printing solutions. By leveraging data, insights, and creative marketing tactics, you’ll ensure that every customer interaction builds loyalty and maximizes lifetime value.
What You'll Do: 
Develop and execute campaigns to drive customer engagement and purchases throughout the whole customer journey - from prospecting to loyal customer across web, email, and other channels.
Design programs for key stages of the customer journey
Develop content and resources that empower customers to maximize the value of their Formlabs products - segmenting by different customer types, geos, etc. as needed
Track, measure, and report on retention and engagement metrics, identifying opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with product, creative, support, and sales teams to bring new products to market, build campaigns, and ensure a seamless customer experience. and launches of new product
Test and optimize campaigns through A/B testing, data analysis, and customer feedback.
About You: 
8+ years in growth, customer, or lifecycle marketing as an analyst, preferably in a hardware technology company
Strong analytical or technical skills  
Strong ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable marketing strategies.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling marketing messages.
A creative mindset with a passion for designing innovative customer campaigns.
A deep understanding of customer needs and a passion for creating exceptional experiences.
Strong bias for action and ability to execute quickly 
Strong curiosity about our customer base, product, and technology 
Experience with marketing email platforms (e.g., Marketo, Klaviyo), CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, BigQuery), ecommerce platforms (e.g., Shopify)
Why Join Us?
Be part of an innovative company at the forefront of the 3D printing industry.
Collaborate with a team of passionate, driven professionals in a fast-paced environment.
Enjoy a culture that values creativity, learning, and delivering excellence.
Our Benefits & Perks:
Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors 
Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats
Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
And of course… unlimited 3D prints

About the role
We're looking for an experienced ASO/SEO & Organic Growth Specialist to take ownership of organic growth across multiple fintech products and markets. You will develop and execute ASO, SEO, SERM, and CRO strategies that drive sustainable user acquisition, improve app store visibility, strengthen brand reputation, and optimize conversion across the customer journey. What You Will Be Doing
Develop and execute ASO strategies for iOS and Android, including metadata, localization, creative assets, ratings, and reviews management.
Own and optimize App Store and Google Play product pages across multiple markets.
Plan, launch, and analyze A/B tests to improve app store conversion rates and organic visibility.
Build and execute SEO, GEO, and AI SEO strategies to increase qualified traffic and user acquisition.
Conduct keyword research, monitor rankings, and continuously optimize organic performance across products and markets.
Develop and oversee SEO-focused content and blog strategies, from topic planning and content briefs to publication and performance analysis.
Manage Search Engine Reputation Management (SERM), monitor brand mentions, and improve brand sentiment across search and review platforms.
Drive CRO initiatives through funnel analysis, landing page optimization, experimentation, and user behavior insights.
Monitor competitors, market trends, and algorithm updates to identify growth opportunities.
Build and maintain dashboards, track KPIs, and continuously optimize strategies based on performance data.
What You Need To Have
3+ years of hands-on experience in ASO and SEO, ideally working with high-traffic mobile applications.
Strong understanding of App Store and Google Play ranking algorithms, optimization techniques, and best practices.
Experience managing keyword strategies, content optimization, and organic growth initiatives across multiple markets.
Proven experience with app ratings and reviews management, SERM, and reputation monitoring.
Experience with CRO, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and data-driven decision-making.
Strong analytical skills and experience with tools such as AppTweak, Ahrefs, AppFigures, BrandMentions, Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Amplitude.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience coordinating cross-functional teams and external contractors.
English level C1 or higher.
Experience in fintech, banking, or multi-market digital products will be considered a strong advantage.
Who You Are
Data-driven and highly analytical, making decisions based on insights rather than assumptions.
Proactive and ownership-oriented, comfortable managing initiatives end-to-end.
Curious about emerging trends in SEO, ASO, AI, and organic growth.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple markets and priorities.
Collaborative and effective at building relationships across product, design, analytics, and marketing teams.

Competitive salary negotiable depending on experience and seniority level.
Share options.
Opportunity to shape organic growth across multiple live fintech products and new market launches.
Full ownership of strategy and execution with direct business impact.
Strong analytics culture and a highly talented international team.
Fully remote work environment.

About the team

At RatePunk, paid acquisition is our growth engine. Our web funnels — from quizzes and landing pages to pricing and checkout — turn that traffic into subscribers. How well they perform directly affects how far we can grow.

We’re looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to own web funnel performance, experimentation, and monetisation. You’ll turn customer insights into hypotheses, launch tests, and use the results to improve conversion and revenue. We also work with an AI-enabled design system, so you can create and ship design variations yourself and move quickly from an idea to a live test.

Get ready to

Own web funnel performance — Take responsibility for conversion across our quizzes, landing pages, pricing and checkout. Find where people drop off and build a clear plan for improvement.

Run our experimentation programme — Own the full process: hypothesis backlog, prioritisation, briefs, launch, analysis and verdict. Build a steady pipeline of meaningful tests and increase the pace of learning.

Test what drives revenue — Experiment with pricing, packaging, offers and how we present them. Evaluate how changes affect both conversion and monetisation.

Build funnels for different audiences — Create and improve funnels for paid, SEO, organic and email traffic, adapting the messaging and purchase journey to each audience’s intent. Develop new funnel concepts and localise them for different markets.

Use AI to create and ship variants — Work with our design system and AI tools to produce design and copy variations, iterate on them, and bring finished test variants to launch.

Turn results into shared learning — Analyse every test, make a clear call on the outcome, and maintain a learning library that helps the team make better decisions.

Drive marketing initiatives forward — Take projects from idea to delivery, from funnel localisation to launches such as our WhatsApp agent. Write clear briefs for developers, coordinate implementation, and work with our Creative Lead to connect funnel insights with ad angles.

We expect you to have

Deep practical experience with A/B testing — you’ve run a high volume of performance tests and know how to prioritise hypotheses worth testing.

Monetisation testing experience — you’ve run multiple pricing, packaging or offer tests and understand how to evaluate their impact on revenue.

Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI extensively for design variations, copy and analysis, and can take an output through to a finished result ready to launch.

Experience with testing tools such as VWO, Optimizely, GrowthBook or split-URL setups, and analytics tools such as GA4 or Plausible.

Strong analytical judgement — you can interpret test results, recognise their limitations and explain what the team should do next.

The ability to coordinate technical work — you can write a clear development brief, discuss implementation with developers and understand the effort involved. You don’t need to code.

A strong understanding of funnel psychology and pricing presentation — you can look at a page, identify a potential barrier to purchase, and turn it into a testable hypothesis.

Strong English conversion copywriting and messaging judgement — you can write and critique headlines, hooks and page copy, and build hypotheses from customer insights.

Big plus if you have experience with:

Subscription/D2C funnels, paid acquisition, funnels for SEO, organic or referral traffic, localisation and multi-market testing, or SQL/BigQuery.

If you’re someone who can combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation and hands-on execution to drive growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary

Gross salary range is 3900-6000 EUR/month.

Location

Vilnius office – we follow a 3-day onsite, 2-day remote hybrid model.

Speaking of perks:

Boost your daily life
Every breakthrough needs a spark, and our daily setup is designed to support it. Enjoy a pet-friendly office, fresh breakfasts, hot lunches, and fully stocked drawers and fridges for a quick snack or even a team-cooked meal together. Rooftop and cellar events keep things lively, while a public transport card for Vilnius and access to Perks.lt benefits help make everyday life a little easier.

Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.”
 At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.
 We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in practice, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics.
 About the role 
 Developers find us, install the SDK, and start processing audio before we ever speak to them. Thousands of accounts have run audio through our models. Some become customers, but many sit somewhere between a first test and real production use. The opportunity is to identify the accounts with real potential, understand what moves them from testing to paying, and find what makes them grow from there.
 You own that journey, from reaching promising developers and teams to converting and growing them. You use product and usage data to decide where to focus, get involved in promising evaluations early, and close startup and mid-market deals. You also experiment with outbound approaches to reach new prospects, identify ways to expand existing customers, and build and test the pricing and operational systems that make the whole motion work.
 This isn't a conventional sales role or a RevOps role. It is a job for someone who wants to do both. If you only want to close, this will frustrate you. If you only want to analyse, you'll be uncomfortable when a number depends on you picking up the phone.
 Tasks
 Signup to paid — Carry the conversion number. Work out which trials are real, get into the evaluation early, cut time-to-value, and remove what's blocking the purchase.
 Outbound — Own the motion end to end: target lists, sequencing, messaging, cadence, and the tooling. Run experiments and double down on what converts.
 Full-cycle sales — Run startup and mid-market deals end to end: discovery, qualification, technical evaluation, pricing, negotiation, close.
 Expansion and retention — Own NRR. Most start on one model and a fraction of their traffic. Find the next use case, catch the accounts going quiet before they churn, win back the ones that left.
 Account intelligence — Build the scoring layer. Turn usage data into a ranked list, and keep the ICP current as the market moves.
 Rev ops and reporting — Own HubSpot, the funnel model and the monthly numbers. You keep them accurate because we make decisions from them, and everyone from the board down reads the numbers you produce.
 Pricing and packaging — Run experiments on the self-serve tiers: what's in each plan, where the limits sit, what triggers an upgrade. Ship, measure, roll out what lifts conversion.
 AI-native operations — Build agents and automations across your whole role, pipeline generation to revenue operations. We already run this way and you'll extend it.
 Voice of customer — Gather feedback from customer interactions so product knows what to build and marketing knows how to position.
 Requirements
 2–5 years in a commercial role at a startup or scale-up, ideally with an AI, developer, API or infrastructure product, where you carried a number and personally owned part of a funnel. You've worked somewhere growing fast and know what it's like when the playbook doesn't exist yet, the targets move, and nobody hands you a territory.
 You've closed. You can talk about specific deals you won and lost, and what you'd do differently.
 Love data. You can build a funnel in a product analytics tool, interrogate a CRM, write a query to check a hunch, and spot when a number is lying to you. We use PostHog and HubSpot.
 Experiment discipline. You can design a test, judge whether the result means anything, and say so when it doesn't.
 Tool fluency. Claude Code, Codex, Lemlist, HubSpot, PostHog. You're fast on the stack and faster picking up what's next.
 Comfortable with a technical buyer. You can follow a conversation about latency, benchmarks, SDK integration and model behaviour, ask useful questions, and know when to bring an engineer in.
 You sell the way developers buy. Our customers evaluate before they talk to anyone and respond to evidence.
 You use AI daily as an operational tool, not an experiment. You build workflows with it and have opinions about where it helps and where it produces noise.
 Strong copywriting skills and written communication. You're able to A/B test copy and see what customers respond to.
 High agency. You're joining a commercial team still being built, with no established playbook. Your instinct should be to go and find out rather than wait to be briefed.
 Commercial generalist. You're comfortable wearing several hats in a day and don't wait for someone to define the lane.
 Working language is English. German is useful and not required.
 Bonus: you've worked in voice AI, speech or audio before. Not a requirement, but it will shorten your first month. Our customers are building voice agents and the vocabulary is specific. Caring about sound and how it works helps.
 Benefits
 Opportunity to work at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup , backed by top investors.
 Compensation and equity: Competitive salary package, additional benefits and stock options, enabling you to take part in the company’s success.
 Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
 High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
 Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
 Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
 Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.
 If you are ready to lead the charge in revolutionizing Voice AI and drive our startup to new heights, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join the ai-coustics team!

· Collaborate with Shopper Experience and Product Media Relations teams to enhance a seamless customer journey across all touchpoints, ensuring social content bridges awareness and conversion

· Collaborate with global marketing and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and effective execution; serve as the local voice and cultural gatekeeper for JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG or other Harman-owned brands expression in Japan

· Translate global product positioning into locally resonant messaging and creative concepts that differentiate JBL within Japan's competitive audio and lifestyle landscape

· Monitor and evaluate campaign performance and social media metrics (engagement rate, share of voice, sentiment, content efficiency), and identify opportunities to continuously optimize activities to improve effectiveness and efficiency

What You Need to Be Successful

· Proven experience in marketing communications, with a strong focus on digital marketing

· Demonstrated ability to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns

· Demonstrated experience in influencer marketing and partnership management, including the ability to build and manage relationships with external creators, media, and strategic partners

· Strong proficiency in English for effective communication in a global business environment, along with native-level Japanese language skills and the ability to create and critically review marketing copy at a high standard in Japanese

· Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

· Solid understanding of brand management and consumer engagement, combined with hands-on experience in social media platforms (such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X), with active engagement in content creation and emerging trends

· Ability to work effectively in a global and cross-functional environment

· Strong understanding of product positioning and brand architecture — ability to translate technical product features into emotional consumer benefits and lifestyle narratives

Bonus Points if You Have

· Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

· Experience in consumer electronics or in marketing globally recognized consumer brands with strong brand equity

· Expertise in social media strategy and content planning

· Experience in e-commerce or performance marketing

· Familiarity with GTM planning and product launch processes

· Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, social media analytics platforms) to measure and optimize campaign performance

· Experience in content creation or storytelling for digital and social media platforms

· Experience in managing agencies or external partners

· Passion for music culture, audio technology, and youth lifestyle trends in Japan

What Makes You Eligible

· Fluency in Japanese and high proficiency in English for business communication

· Eligibility to work in Japan

· Be willing to travel up to 5%, domestic only

· Be willing to work in the office (Harman flex policy allows office/remote work in alignment with your manager)

· Successfully complete a background investigation/Aptitude Test as a condition of employment

What We Offer

· Opportunity to work with globally recognized audio brands such as JBL, Harman Kardon, and Mark Levinson

· A collaborative and international work environment within a global organization

· Exposure to end-to-end marketing activities across multiple channels and touchpoints

· Opportunities for professional growth and development in marketing and brand management

· A dynamic workplace that encourages innovation, creativity, and continuous learning

What You’ll Do
Acquire new enterprise merchants by identifying opportunities, building relationships, managing sales cycles, and closing deals.
Manage and grow strategic merchant accounts throughout the full client lifecycle, from onboarding and integration to ongoing optimization and expansion.
Develop strong relationships with key merchants and become a trusted business partner, understanding their challenges and providing tailored payment solutions.
Drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities by identifying business growth areas and increasing adoption of Unlimit’s payment solutions.
Analyze merchant performance data, monitor key business metrics, and provide insights and recommendations to improve transaction performance and revenue growth.
Collaborate closely with product, operations, risk, compliance, and technical teams to ensure successful merchant experience and continuous improvement.
Manage multiple priorities and stakeholders while delivering results in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
Represent Unlimit as a strategic partner, bringing ownership, professionalism, and commercial mindset to every client interaction.
Who You Are
Payments experience: minimum 5 years of experience in the payments industry, with strong knowledge of acquiring, merchant services, payment solutions, or payment partnerships.
Enterprise sales experience: proven experience managing complex sales cycles with enterprise merchants, including prospecting, negotiation, and closing.

Why Work Here? 
 HypeAuditor is a leading B2B influencer marketing platform with customers from all around the world. We provide tools and reports for influencer search on Instagram, Tiktok, Youtube, Twitch, Twitter, and Snapchat. HypeAuditor is a data provider trusted by the biggest media outlets like Forbes, Social Media Today, The Washington Post, Business Insider, Entrepreneur, and PR Week. Founded back in 2018, HypeAuditor acquired more than 1,500,000+ clients. We’re honored to be named one of America's Best Startup Employers 2021-2022, 2024, 2026 by Forbes
 Job Overview 
 We’re looking for a Content & SEO Writer who can create useful, well-researched content that deserves to rank and is worth reading once people get there.
 The main focus of this role is long-form and SEO content. This includes blog articles, pillar pages, research-based content, product and solution pages, comparison pages, free tools, templates, and other content built around organic search and our broader marketing goals.
 Research is a major part of the job. We don’t want content that simply summarizes what already exists on the first page of Google. You should be comfortable digging into a topic, working with different sources, analyzing competitors, talking to internal experts when needed, and turning what you learn into something clear, specific, and genuinely useful.
 You’ll also work with AI tools as part of the content process. We expect you to know where AI saves time and where it makes content worse. You should be able to direct it, challenge its output, fact-check it, rewrite it, and spot generic AI copy immediately. Our stance is that AI can support the work but it should never be the one making the editorial decisions.
 What you’ll work on 
 Your main responsibility will be creating and improving content across several areas:
 Write in-depth blog articles, pillar pages, research pieces, guides, and other long-form content.
 Create SEO-focused pages for products, solutions, free tools, templates, comparisons, topics, agencies, reviews, API/MCP-related use cases, and other parts of the HypeAuditor website.
 Update existing blog and website content when rankings, search intent, product information, or market conditions change.
 Research topics before writing. This may include SERP analysis, competitor research, industry sources, reports, original data, customer insights, and input from internal experts.
 Turn complex information, product functionality, and data into content that is easy to understand without oversimplifying it.
 Work with SEO requirements such as search intent, keywords, page structure, internal linking, metadata, and content gaps without making the text sound as if it was written for a search engine.
 Help build and maintain content clusters and pillar strategies.
 Support selected marketing projects such as newsletters, email sequences, landing pages, and campaign content when needed.
 Edit and improve existing content for clarity, accuracy, usefulness, structure, and tone.
 Work with SEO, Product, Marketing, Design, and other teams to gather information and get content published.
 Review content performance and use the results to improve existing pages and inform future content.
 What we’re looking for 
 3+ years of professional writing experience, with a strong portfolio of long-form content.
 Excellent written English . You should be able to write clearly, naturally, and precisely for an international and US-focused audience.
 Strong research skills. You know how to investigate a topic rather than simply rewrite existing articles.
 Practical SEO knowledge. You understand search intent, keywords, SERPs, content gaps, page structure, internal linking, and on-page SEO.
 The ability to balance SEO requirements with readability and actual value for the reader.
 Experience writing about SaaS, B2B, marketing, technology, or another field where understanding the subject matters as much as writing about it.
 The ability to understand complex concepts quickly and explain them in plain English.
 Good editorial judgment. You can tell the difference between a useful paragraph and one that merely sounds polished.
 Strong fact-checking habits and attention to detail.
 The ability to work independently, take ownership of a piece from research to final draft, and know when you need input from someone else.
 Experience using AI tools as part of a professional writing workflow.
 .
 How we expect you to work with AI 
 AI proficiency for us does not mean being good at generating an article from one prompt.
 You should know how to use AI for tasks where it actually helps: exploring a topic, working through ideas, organizing research, testing structures, processing information, editing, or speeding up repetitive parts of the workflow.
 At the same time, you should be able to recognize its limitations. That means catching unsupported claims, shallow reasoning, fake specificity, repetitive structures, awkward phrasing, unnecessary summaries, inflated language, and text that says a lot without giving the reader much information.
 You will remain responsible for the research, argument, structure, accuracy, tone, and final quality of everything you publish.
 Nice to have 
 Experience with influencer marketing or MarTech would be useful, as would experience with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4, Google Search Console, and CMS platforms.
 Experience working with original datasets, surveys, experts, or research reports would also be a strong advantage.

 • 100% paid sick leave, 20 working days of annual leave per year, the option to choose days off for public holidays (an additional 13 days of annual leave per year);
 • Absence of bureaucracy, flexibility, and speed in decision-making;
 • Preferential conditions for health insurance;
 • Quick interview process;
 • Fully remote job;
 • Great team & supportive colleagues 🙂

Readdle is a pioneering force in the personal productivity space on Apple devices, having shaped the landscape since 2007. Our mission is to empower individuals and teams with innovative technology, enhancing their efficiency and creativity. We are dedicated to crafting exceptional mobile and desktop experiences for those who aspire to achieve more.



As a Senior Growth Analyst at Readdle, you'll own the numbers behind how Calendars grows and proactively discover opportunities and validate the impact of initiatives. From the first ad impression to long-term renewals, you'll make sense of the data, design event structures, and ensure everything is measurable. You'll dig into funnels, uncover insights, and build dashboards that make growth performance crystal clear for product and marketing teams.

 

What will you do:

Transform and analyze large datasets in BigQuery and Amplitude to discover product & growth opportunities, trends, anomalies, and actionable insights across the user journey.
Build and maintain self-serve reports that enable stakeholders to answer key questions with data and establish a clear source-of-truth for growth metrics.
Define, document, and QA event structures for new features, campaigns, and experiments; build a robust monetization measurement system to support pricing and migration decisions.
Analyze user funnels across ads, store, onboarding, in-app usage, purchases, and cancellations to identify drop-offs and growth opportunities.
Design, sequence, and monitor A/B experiments and feature launches; validate results and ensure statistical rigor & consistent long-term impact tracking.
Proactively surface insights, hypotheses, and growth opportunities to marketing and product teams; shape quarterly prioritization with discoveries from data and impact scenarios to influence roadmap decisions.
Build forecasting and scenario models for installs, conversions, retention, and revenue.
Ensure data integrity across tools and pipelines through established QA processes; work with measurement vendors to meaningfully track attribution and optimize acquisition reporting.

 

About you:

4+ years in growth, product, or marketing analytics in a B2C or SaaS environment, with experience working on user acquisition, pricing, monetization, and/or migration initiatives in subscription-based products.
Strong SQL skills and experience with BigQuery or similar cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake); proficiency in Tableau/Looker/etc. for reporting and complex data visualization and product analytics tooling. Amplitude/Mixpanel/Heap/Hotjar/PostHog for event/property tracking and user journey tracking.
Experience with marketing attribution platforms (Appsflyer/Adjust/Kochava/etc.); familiarity with Python/R for data analysis and automation. Experience with ML or time-series inference is a strong plus.
Solid understanding of product analytics (funnels, cohorts, retention, event tracking), marketing analytics (incl. attribution, MMM, incrementality testing, etc.), statistics, experimentation, and experience with segmentation and modeling churn or LTV. Demonstrable advanced analytics experience (causal inference, quasi-experiments, linear programming, econometrics, etc.) is highly advantageous for the role.
Proven ability to design self-serve dashboards and act as a strategic thought partner to PM/PMM teams, not just an executor of analytics requests.
Solid business acumen. Comfortable working cross-functionally with product, marketing, and engineering teams with a proactive, curious, and coachable mindset.

What you will get at Readdle:

Customer-centric culture. We put our users at the heart of everything we do. Every team member has the opportunity to engage directly with customers, gaining insights that shape meaningful, delightful experiences for millions worldwide.
Relentless growth. We’re committed to mastery in our craft. We take ownership of our work, decisions, and outcomes, and we see feedback as a catalyst for growth. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn, evolve, and raise the bar.
Exceptional people, exceptional team. Our greatest strength is our people. We care deeply about each other, work transparently, and celebrate collective success. Together, we build an environment where everyone can do their best work and grow beyond their potential.
Real impact. We design products that truly matter. Our focus is on delivering tangible value, simplifying complexity, pushing boundaries, and continuously improving how we build and deliver solutions to our users.
Culture of innovation. We embrace curiosity and creativity in everything we do. Fresh ideas are not just welcomed, they’re expected, celebrated, and turned into real innovations that shape the future of our products and company.

Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “ teaching machines to hear like human beings. ”
 At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like PolyAI, LiveKit, Telnyx, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.
 We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers.
 About the role 
 We have a small but mighty marketing team that produce excellent content and campaigns — launches, videos, case studies, and a brand that punches above our size. What we need is someone who can ensure that these reach the right people at the right time and build a growth engine around them.
 That's this role. You'll drive the growth side of marketing at ai-coustics: the measurement that tells us what's working, the new channel experiments that help us expand reach, and the funnel that converts signups into active and happy developers. You'll also be the bridge into sales — surfacing the accounts worth chasing, and turning our content into the material that helps close them.
 Tasks
 Funnel and conversion — Manage the path from content to signup to activated user: CTA strategy by channel, landing pages, onboarding flow.
 Lifecycle and email — Build the email programme looking at onboarding, activation, re-engagement, launch sends.
 Organic discovery — Run SEO and GEO as a continuous programme, including how we surface inside LLMs.
 Experimentation — Run a steady cadence of tests across pages, messaging and channels, including our first paid experiments. Form a hypothesis, ship it, evaluate, and expand.
 Account-based marketing — Work with our sales and partnerships team to identify and outreach to our target accounts, build and act on intent signals on our website and product, building sales enablement materials and personalised campaigns that capture their attention.
 Measurement and attribution — Own the analytics layer and reporting across PostHog and HubSpot: the events, funnels and dashboards that show where developers and accounts come from, and where they drop off.
 AI-native operations — Build agents and automations into your own workflows, from research and reporting to campaign ops.
 Requirements
 1–3 years in growth, lifecycle, performance or product marketing, where you personally owned a channel or a funnel and can show what changed because of you.
 Genuinely comfortable with data. You can set up event tracking, build a funnel in a product analytics tool, interrogate a CRM, and spot when a number is lying to you.
 Hands-on with the tooling: product analytics (we use PostHog), CRM and marketing automation (HubSpot), and the CMS and email tools around them.
 You use AI daily as an operational tool, not an experiment. You build workflows with it, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it produces noise.
 You write clearly — well enough to ship an email sequence, a landing page or a sales one-pager without a handoff. Not a content specialist, but you know what great looks like.
 You've worked alongside sales in a B2B setting and understand that marketing's job is pipeline, not traffic. You'd rather review customer call notes than guess what buyers care about.
 Comfortable working with engineers to get things shipped — tracking implemented, signup flow changed, site fixed. You can write a clear ticket, and hold your ground on why it matters.
 Fast learner with high agency. You're joining a function with no established playbook, and your instinct is to go and find out rather than wait to be briefed.
 Comfortable marketing to developers, or clearly motivated to learn how. Our audience is engineers building voice products, and they are unusually good at ignoring marketing.
 Working language is English.

 Opportunity to work at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup , backed by top investors.
 Compensation and equity: Competitive salary package, additional benefits and stock options, enabling you to take part in the company’s success.
 Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
 High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
 Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
 Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
 Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.
